lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們不是要在日本玩一個星期嗎？怎麼今天就回來了？
lines.simplified: 你们不是要在日本玩一个星期吗？怎么今天就回来了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bú shì yào zài Rìběn wán yí ge xīngqí ma? Zěnme jīntiān jiù huílái le?
lines.english: Weren't you going to spend a week in Japan? How come you're back today?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們才玩了三天就回來了。不是天氣的問題，那幾天的天氣好得很。
lines.simplified: 我们才玩了三天就回来了。不是天气的问题，那几天的天气好得很。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen cái wán le sān tiān jiù huílái le. Bú shì tiānqì de wèntí, nà jǐ tiān de tiānqì hǎo de hěn.
lines.english: We'd only been there three days when we came back. It wasn't the weather: the weather was great those days.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那是怎麼回事？錢花完了嗎？
lines.simplified: 那是怎么回事？钱花完了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà shì zěnme huíshì? Qián huā wán le ma?
lines.english: Then what happened? Did you run out of money?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 錢倒是還有。是我朋友的護照不見了，他下個月就要去美國念書了。
lines.simplified: 钱倒是还有。是我朋友的护照不见了，他下个月就要去美国念书了。
lines.pinyin: Qián dàoshì hái yǒu. Shì wǒ péngyǒu de hùzhào bújiàn le, tā xià ge yuè jiù yào qù Měiguó niànshū le.
lines.english: We still have money. It's that my friend lost his passport, and he's leaving to study in the US next month.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們才玩了三天就回來，是因為朋友得趕回來做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 他们才玩了三天就回来，是因为朋友得赶回来做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen cái wán le sān tiān jiù huílái, shì yīnwèi péngyǒu děi gǎn huílái zuò shénme?
prompt.english: They came back after only three days because the friend had to hurry back to do what?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 準備去美國念書的行李
choices.simplified: 准备去美国念书的行李
choices.pinyin: Zhǔnbèi qù Měiguó niànshū de xínglǐ.
choices.english: Pack for studying in the US.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù yínháng zài lǐng yìxiē qián.
choices.english: Go to the bank for more money.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn Měiguó de xuéxiào liánluò.
choices.english: Contact the school in the US.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chóngxīn bàn yì běn hùzhào.
choices.english: Get a new passport made.

questions.why: 才玩了三天就回來了 says the trip ended far earlier than planned. Without a passport he cannot fly to the US next month, so he must get a new one first. Packing for the US is not urgent, and the money is fine (錢倒是還有).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我上個週末寫的那篇旅行日記，才放上部落格兩天，就有三千多個人看了。
lines.simplified: 我上个周末写的那篇旅行日记，才放上部落格两天，就有三千多个人看了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge zhōumò xiě de nà piān lǚxíng rìjì, cái fàng shàng bùluògé liǎng tiān, jiù yǒu sānqiān duō ge rén kàn le.
lines.english: The travel diary I wrote last weekend has only been on my blog for two days, and over three thousand people have read it already.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是因為妳的照片拍得很漂亮吧？
lines.simplified: 是因为你的照片拍得很漂亮吧？
lines.pinyin: Shì yīnwèi nǐ de zhàopiàn pāi de hěn piàoliàng ba?
lines.english: It's because your photos are so beautiful, right?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 照片倒是沒什麼特別的。是我把怎麼坐車、住哪裡、花了多少錢都寫得很詳細，很多人留言說很有用。
lines.simplified: 照片倒是没什么特别的。是我把怎么坐车、住哪里、花了多少钱都写得很详细，很多人留言说很有用。
lines.pinyin: Zhàopiàn dàoshì méi shénme tèbié de. Shì wǒ bǎ zěnme zuò chē, zhù nǎlǐ, huā le duōshǎo qián dōu xiě de hěn xiángxì, hěn duō rén liúyán shuō hěn yǒuyòng.
lines.english: The photos are nothing special, actually. It's that I wrote down in detail how to get around, where to stay and how much I spent. Lots of people commented that it was really useful.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣的資料，去旅行的人最需要了。
lines.simplified: 这样的资料，去旅行的人最需要了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng de zīliào, qù lǚxíng de rén zuì xūyào le.
lines.english: That kind of information is exactly what travellers need most.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那篇日記為什麼這麼快就有很多人看？
prompt.simplified: 那篇日记为什么这么快就有很多人看？
prompt.pinyin: Nà piān rìjì wèishénme zhème kuài jiù yǒu hěn duō rén kàn?
prompt.english: Why did so many people read that diary so quickly?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhàopiàn pāi de hěn hǎokàn.
choices.english: The photos are very good.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiě le hěn duō hǎowán de shì.
choices.english: It tells lots of fun stories.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù de dìfāng hěn yǒumíng.
choices.english: The places she went are famous.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǚxíng de zīliào hěn qīngchǔ.
choices.english: The travel information is very clear.

questions.why: 才放上部落格兩天，就有三千多個人看了 says it caught on fast; she says the reason is the detailed practical information (寫得很詳細……很有用). The beautiful photos were only the man's guess, and she says they are nothing special.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這次去日本，我想一個人去。想去哪裡就去哪裡，不用等別人。
lines.simplified: 这次去日本，我想一个人去。想去哪里就去哪里，不用等别人。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì qù Rìběn, wǒ xiǎng yí ge rén qù. Xiǎng qù nǎlǐ jiù qù nǎlǐ, búyòng děng biérén.
lines.english: This time I want to go to Japan on my own. I can go wherever I like without waiting for anyone.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一個人是比較自由。不過話說回來，你一句日文都不會說，萬一碰到問題，誰幫你？
lines.simplified: 一个人是比较自由。不过话说回来，你一句日文都不会说，万一碰到问题，谁帮你？
lines.pinyin: Yí ge rén shì bǐjiào zìyóu. Búguò huà shuō huílái, nǐ yí jù Rìwén dōu bú huì shuō, wànyī pèngdào wèntí, shéi bāng nǐ?
lines.english: Going alone is freer, sure. But then again, you can't speak a word of Japanese. If you run into a problem, who will help you?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也對。我哥哥在日本念過書，日文說得很好，我問問他有沒有空陪我。
lines.simplified: 也对。我哥哥在日本念过书，日文说得很好，我问问他有没有空陪我。
lines.pinyin: Yě duì. Wǒ gēge zài Rìběn niàn guo shū, Rìwén shuō de hěn hǎo, wǒ wènwen tā yǒu méiyǒu kòng péi wǒ.
lines.english: Fair point. My older brother studied in Japan and speaks Japanese well. I'll ask if he's free to go with me.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有他陪你，我就放心了。
lines.simplified: 有他陪你，我就放心了。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu tā péi nǐ, wǒ jiù fàngxīn le.
lines.english: With him along, I won't worry.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼不想一個人去了？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么不想一个人去了？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme bù xiǎng yí ge rén qù le?
prompt.english: Why does the man no longer want to go alone?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí ge rén qù bǐ liǎng ge rén guì.
choices.english: Going alone costs more than going as two.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí ge rén wán huì bǐjiào wúliáo.
choices.english: Travelling alone would be boring.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 有事的時候沒辦法用日文問人
choices.simplified: 有事的时候没办法用日文问人
choices.pinyin: Yǒu shì de shíhòu méi bànfǎ yòng Rìwén wèn rén.
choices.english: If something happens he can't ask anyone in Japanese.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēge gānghǎo yě xiǎng qù Rìběn.
choices.english: His brother happens to want to go to Japan too.

questions.why: She grants his point (一個人是比較自由), then 不過話說回來 raises the bigger problem: he speaks no Japanese, so if something goes wrong he can't ask for help. He agrees (也對). His brother is the fix, not the reason, and nobody says the brother wants to go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這家民宿在山上，很偏僻，手機訊號也很弱。下次別住這裡了吧。
lines.simplified: 这家民宿在山上，很偏僻，手机讯号也很弱。下次别住这里了吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā mínsù zài shān shàng, hěn piānpì, shǒujī xùnhào yě hěn ruò. Xià cì bié zhù zhèlǐ le ba.
lines.english: This guesthouse is up in the mountains, really remote, and the phone signal is weak. Let's not stay here next time.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不方便是不方便。可是話說回來，妳不是說想找個安靜的地方，好好休息幾天嗎？
lines.simplified: 不方便是不方便。可是话说回来，你不是说想找个安静的地方，好好休息几天吗？
lines.pinyin: Bù fāngbiàn shì bù fāngbiàn. Kěshì huà shuō huílái, nǐ bú shì shuō xiǎng zhǎo ge ānjìng de dìfāng, hǎohǎo xiūxí jǐ tiān ma?
lines.english: It's inconvenient, yes. But then again, didn't you say you wanted somewhere quiet to rest properly for a few days?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 也是。住在這裡，公司的人也找不到我。
lines.simplified: 也是。住在这里，公司的人也找不到我。
lines.pinyin: Yě shì. Zhù zài zhèlǐ, gōngsī de rén yě zhǎo bú dào wǒ.
lines.english: True. Staying here, nobody from work can reach me either.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，這幾天妳就好好休息吧。
lines.simplified: 对啊，这几天你就好好休息吧。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, zhè jǐ tiān nǐ jiù hǎohǎo xiūxí ba.
lines.english: Right, so just get some proper rest these few days.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「話說回來」，是想告訴女的什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「话说回来」，是想告诉女的什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō “huà shuō huílái”, shì xiǎng gàosu nǚ de shénme?
prompt.english: When the man says "but then again", what does he want to tell the woman?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 山上的民宿都這麼不方便
choices.simplified: 山上的民宿都这么不方便
choices.pinyin: Shān shàng de mínsù dōu zhème bù fāngbiàn.
choices.english: All mountain guesthouses are this inconvenient.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她應該先把公司的事處理好
choices.simplified: 她应该先把公司的事处理好
choices.pinyin: Tā yīnggāi xiān bǎ gōngsī de shì chǔlǐ hǎo.
choices.english: She should sort out her work first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下次換一家民宿比較好
choices.simplified: 下次换一家民宿比较好
choices.pinyin: Xià cì huàn yì jiā mínsù bǐjiào hǎo.
choices.english: Next time another guesthouse would be better.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不方便的地方，正好能休息
choices.simplified: 不方便的地方，正好能休息
choices.pinyin: Bù fāngbiàn de dìfāng, zhènghǎo néng xiūxí.
choices.english: An inconvenient place is just right for resting.

questions.why: 不方便是不方便 agrees it is inconvenient; 可是話說回來 then reminds her she wanted somewhere quiet to rest, so the remote place suits her. Changing guesthouses was her idea, which he is answering, and work comes up only when she agrees with him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我昨天上網查了，臺灣人去那個國家不用辦簽證，而且一次最多可以玩九十天。
lines.simplified: 我昨天上网查了，台湾人去那个国家不用办签证，而且一次最多可以玩九十天。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān shàngwǎng chá le, Táiwān rén qù nàge guójiā búyòng bàn qiānzhèng, érqiě yí cì zuì duō kěyǐ wán jiǔshí tiān.
lines.english: I checked online yesterday: Taiwanese people need no visa for that country, and can stay up to ninety days at a time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼說，我們不用只去兩個星期了？
lines.simplified: 这么说，我们不用只去两个星期了？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, wǒmen búyòng zhǐ qù liǎng ge xīngqí le?
lines.english: So we don't have to go for just two weeks?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。暑假有兩個月，我們可以去一個月，多看幾個地方。
lines.simplified: 对啊。暑假有两个月，我们可以去一个月，多看几个地方。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Shǔjià yǒu liǎng ge yuè, wǒmen kěyǐ qù yí ge yuè, duō kàn jǐ ge dìfāng.
lines.english: Right. The summer holiday is two months long, so we can go for a month and see a few more places.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊！那我今天晚上就上網看機票。
lines.simplified: 好啊！那我今天晚上就上网看机票。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nà wǒ jīntiān wǎnshàng jiù shàngwǎng kàn jīpiào.
lines.english: Great! Then I'll look at flights online tonight.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼想改變旅行的計畫？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么想改变旅行的计画？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme xiǎng gǎibiàn lǚxíng de jìhuà?
prompt.english: Why do they want to change their travel plan?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qiānzhèng yìzhí bàn bú xiàlái.
choices.english: They can't get a visa.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Néng wán de shíjiān bǐ xiǎng de cháng.
choices.english: They can stay longer than they thought.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shǔjià bǐ qùnián duō yí ge yuè.
choices.english: The summer holiday is a month longer than last year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīpiào bǐ shàng ge yuè piányí.
choices.english: Flights are cheaper than last month.

questions.why: No visa and up to ninety days: 這麼說 draws the conclusion that they no longer have to keep it to two weeks, so they stretch it to a month. A visa is not needed at all, and two months is simply how long the holiday is.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們班上選代表的結果出來了嗎？聽說你也出來選了。
lines.simplified: 你们班上选代表的结果出来了吗？听说你也出来选了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bān shàng xuǎn dàibiǎo de jiéguǒ chūlái le ma? Tīngshuō nǐ yě chūlái xuǎn le.
lines.english: Is the result of your class representative vote out? I heard you ran too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 出來了。我拿到二十票，跟我一起選的那個女同學拿到十二票。
lines.simplified: 出来了。我拿到二十票，跟我一起选的那个女同学拿到十二票。
lines.pinyin: Chūlái le. Wǒ ná dào èrshí piào, gēn wǒ yìqǐ xuǎn de nà ge nǚ tóngxué ná dào shí'èr piào.
lines.english: It is. I got twenty votes and the girl running against me got twelve.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼說，你當選了！恭喜你！
lines.simplified: 这么说，你当选了！恭喜你！
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, nǐ dāngxuǎn le! Gōngxǐ nǐ!
lines.english: So you've been elected! Congratulations!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 謝謝。不過以後開會、幫同學問事情都得我去，打工的時間恐怕得少一點。
lines.simplified: 谢谢。不过以后开会、帮同学问事情都得我去，打工的时间恐怕得少一点。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie. Búguò yǐhòu kāihuì, bāng tóngxué wèn shìqíng dōu děi wǒ qù, dǎgōng de shíjiān kǒngpà děi shǎo yìdiǎn.
lines.english: Thanks. But from now on I'll have to go to the meetings and ask about things for the class, so I'm afraid I'll have to work fewer part-time hours.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這次選舉以後，男的生活可能會有什麼改變？
prompt.simplified: 这次选举以后，男的生活可能会有什么改变？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè cì xuǎnjǔ yǐhòu, nán de shēnghuó kěnéng huì yǒu shénme gǎibiàn?
prompt.english: After this vote, how might the man's life change?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎgōng de qián kěnéng shǎo yìxiē.
choices.english: He may earn a bit less from his part-time job.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děi chángcháng bāng nà ge nǚ tóngxué.
choices.english: He will often have to help the girl who ran.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǐhòu dōu bù néng qù dǎgōng le.
choices.english: He won't be able to work part-time at all.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 得花時間準備下次選舉
choices.simplified: 得花时间准备下次选举
choices.pinyin: Děi huā shíjiān zhǔnbèi xià cì xuǎnjǔ.
choices.english: He must spend time preparing for the next vote.

questions.why: Twenty votes against twelve, so 這麼說，你當選了: he won, and as representative he will work fewer hours (打工的時間恐怕得少一點), so he earns less. He works less, not never, and the vote is already over.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上次借我的那本旅遊書，我看完了。什麼時候還妳？
lines.simplified: 你上次借我的那本旅游书，我看完了。什么时候还你？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng cì jiè wǒ de nà běn lǚyóu shū, wǒ kàn wán le. Shénme shíhòu huán nǐ?
lines.english: I've finished the travel book you lent me. When shall I give it back?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不急。你下個月不是也要去日本嗎？帶著去吧。
lines.simplified: 不急。你下个月不是也要去日本吗？带着去吧。
lines.pinyin: Bù jí. Nǐ xià ge yuè bú shì yě yào qù Rìběn ma? Dài zhe qù ba.
lines.english: No hurry. Aren't you going to Japan next month too? Take it with you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我要去的是北部，可是書裡寫的大多是南部的景點。
lines.simplified: 我要去的是北部，可是书里写的大多是南部的景点。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù de shì běibù, kěshì shū lǐ xiě de dàduō shì nánbù de jǐngdiǎn.
lines.english: I'm going to the north, but the book is mostly about places in the south.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 既然這樣，你就別帶了，下次見面再還我就好。
lines.simplified: 既然这样，你就别带了，下次见面再还我就好。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán zhèyàng, nǐ jiù bié dài le, xià cì jiànmiàn zài huán wǒ jiù hǎo.
lines.english: In that case, don't take it. Just give it back next time we meet.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼後來說男的不用帶書去？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么后来说男的不用带书去？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme hòulái shuō nán de búyòng dài shū qù?
prompt.english: Why does the woman then say he need not take the book?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zìjǐ zuìjìn yě yào yòng.
choices.english: She needs it herself soon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de yǐjīng kàn wán le.
choices.english: He has already read it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shū lǐ de dìfāng tā bú qù.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: The book is too heavy to carry.

questions.why: 既然這樣 points back to what he just said: the book covers the south and he is going north, so it is no use on his trip. Having read it was why he offered to return it, not why she changed her advice.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你爸爸不是不喜歡出國嗎？這次怎麼跟你們去歐洲了？
lines.simplified: 你爸爸不是不喜欢出国吗？这次怎么跟你们去欧洲了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bàba bú shì bù xǐhuān chūguó ma? Zhè cì zěnme gēn nǐmen qù Ōuzhōu le?
lines.english: Doesn't your dad dislike going abroad? How come he went to Europe with you this time?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我也以為他不會去。沒想到他看了我姊姊在部落格上放的照片，自己說要去。
lines.simplified: 我也以为他不会去。没想到他看了我姐姐在部落格上放的照片，自己说要去。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě yǐwéi tā bú huì qù. Méixiǎngdào tā kàn le wǒ jiějie zài bùluògé shàng fàng de zhàopiàn, zìjǐ shuō yào qù.
lines.english: I thought he wouldn't go either. But after he saw the photos my sister put on her blog, he said himself that he wanted to go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那他玩得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 那他玩得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā wán de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: So how did he enjoy it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他一連玩了十天，每天走很多路，一點都不累，比我們都有精神。
lines.simplified: 他一连玩了十天，每天走很多路，一点都不累，比我们都有精神。
lines.pinyin: Tā yìlián wán le shí tiān, měi tiān zǒu hěn duō lù, yìdiǎn dōu bú lèi, bǐ wǒmen dōu yǒu jīngshén.
lines.english: He toured for ten days in a row, walking a lot every day, without getting tired at all. He had more energy than any of us.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的對爸爸這次的旅行，最可能有什麼想法？

choices.pinyin: Bàba bǐ tā xiǎng de gèng ài chūqù wán.

choices.speaker: N

choices.pinyin: Dānxīn bàba zǒu tài duō lù huì lèi huài.

choices.speaker: N

choices.pinyin: Bàba shì wèile jiějie cái qù de.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: His father still dislikes going abroad.

questions.why: 以為……沒想到……: he thought his father wouldn't go, yet the father chose to go himself and outlasted everyone over ten days of walking. Not liking travel was the old belief, and the father was not tired at all (一點都不累).

intro.speaker: N

intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們上個週末去小島玩，怎麼樣？照片拍了很多吧？
lines.simplified: 你们上个周末去小岛玩，怎么样？照片拍了很多吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen shàng ge zhōumò qù xiǎo dǎo wán, zěnmeyàng? Zhàopiàn pāi le hěn duō ba?
lines.english: How was your trip to the little island last weekend? You must have taken lots of photos.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 別說了，我們沒去成。到了機場才知道，那天風太大，飛機不能飛。
lines.simplified: 别说了，我们没去成。到了机场才知道，那天风太大，飞机不能飞。
lines.pinyin: Bié shuō le, wǒmen méi qù chéng. Dào le jīchǎng cái zhīdào, nà tiān fēng tài dà, fēijī bù néng fēi.
lines.english: Don't ask. We never made it. Only at the airport did we find out the wind was too strong that day for planes to fly.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你們後來怎麼辦？沒有在附近住一晚，第二天再去嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你们后来怎么办？没有在附近住一晚，第二天再去吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen hòulái zěnme bàn? Méiyǒu zài fùjìn zhù yì wǎn, dì èr tiān zài qù ma?
lines.english: So what did you do in the end? Didn't you stay nearby for a night and go the next day?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們本來是這麼想的。可是氣象預報說，大風會一連吹三天，我們只有兩天假，只好回家了。
lines.simplified: 我们本来是这么想的。可是气象预报说，大风会一连吹三天，我们只有两天假，只好回家了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái shì zhème xiǎng de. Kěshì qìxiàng yùbào shuō, dà fēng huì yìlián chuī sān tiān, wǒmen zhǐyǒu liǎng tiān jià, zhǐhǎo huíjiā le.
lines.english: That was our plan at first. But the weather forecast said the strong wind would blow for three days in a row, and we only had two days off, so we had to go home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真可惜。那機票的錢呢？
lines.simplified: 真可惜。那机票的钱呢？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn kěxí. Nà jīpiào de qián ne?
lines.english: What a pity. And the money for the tickets?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 錢倒是都拿回來了。下個月放假的時候，我們想再去一次。
lines.simplified: 钱倒是都拿回来了。下个月放假的时候，我们想再去一次。
lines.pinyin: Qián dàoshì dōu ná huílái le. Xià ge yuè fàngjià de shíhòu, wǒmen xiǎng zài qù yí cì.
lines.english: We did get all the money back. We want to try again during next month's holiday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後為什麼只好回家？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后为什么只好回家？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu wèishénme zhǐhǎo huíjiā?
prompt.english: Why did they end up having to go home?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 機場附近的旅館都住滿了
choices.simplified: 机场附近的旅馆都住满了
choices.pinyin: Jīchǎng fùjìn de lǚguǎn dōu zhù mǎn le.
choices.english: The hotels near the airport were full.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 風停的時候，假已經用完了
choices.simplified: 风停的时候，假已经用完了
choices.pinyin: Fēng tíng de shíhòu, jià yǐjīng yòng wán le.
choices.english: By the time the wind stopped, their days off would be gone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 機場說三天以後才賣新的票
choices.simplified: 机场说三天以后才卖新的票
choices.pinyin: Jīchǎng shuō sān tiān yǐhòu cái mài xīn de piào.
choices.english: The airport would only sell new tickets in three days.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 得先回家才拿得回機票錢
choices.simplified: 得先回家才拿得回机票钱
choices.pinyin: Děi xiān huíjiā cái ná de huí jīpiào qián.
choices.english: They had to go home to get the ticket money back.

questions.why: The wind would blow 一連三天 (three days in a row) but they only had two days off, so waiting it out was impossible. The three days are the forecast for the wind, not a ticket rule, and the refund is mentioned only afterwards.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的接下來對這趟旅行有什麼打算？
prompt.simplified: 男的接下来对这趟旅行有什么打算？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jiēxiàlái duì zhè tàng lǚxíng yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?

choices.speaker: N

choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè zài qù, děi chóngxīn mǎi piào.
choices.english: Go next month, buying tickets again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下個月再去，用原來的機票

choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè zài qù, yòng yuánlái de jīpiào.
choices.english: Go next month on the original tickets.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Go the day after the wind stops.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qián ná huílái le, bù xiǎng zài qù.
choices.english: The money is back, so he won't go again.

questions.why: 沒去成: the trip never happened, the ticket money was refunded (錢倒是都拿回來了), and they want to try again next month, so they will need new tickets. Going the next day was only the first idea, dropped because of the three-day wind.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那現在呢？
lines.simplified: 那现在呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà xiànzài ne?
lines.english: And now?

lines.traditional: 後來我們把時間改到期末考考完以後，一下子就多了十五個人報名。
lines.simplified: 后来我们把时间改到期末考考完以后，一下子就多了十五个人报名。
lines.pinyin: Hòulái wǒmen bǎ shíjiān gǎi dào qímòkǎo kǎo wán yǐhòu, yíxiàzi jiù duō le shíwǔ ge rén bàomíng.
lines.english: Then we moved it to after the final exams, and straight away fifteen more people signed up.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼說，下個月去得成了？
lines.simplified: 这么说，下个月去得成了？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, xià ge yuè qù de chéng le?
lines.english: So you can go next month after all?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。不過原來訂的那家民宿，最多只能住二十個人，我得再找一家。
lines.simplified: 对啊。不过原来订的那家民宿，最多只能住二十个人，我得再找一家。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Búguò yuánlái dìng de nà jiā mínsù, zuì duō zhǐ néng zhù èrshí ge rén, wǒ děi zài zhǎo yì jiā.
lines.english: Yes. But the guesthouse we booked only takes twenty people at most, so I have to find another one.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大家好，我是一個背包客，這十年來，一個人去過二十幾個國家。很多人覺得女生一個人旅行很危險。不過就我的經驗來說，其實很少碰到壞人，比較麻煩的是生病。
lines.simplified: 大家好，我是一个背包客，这十年来，一个人去过二十几个国家。很多人觉得女生一个人旅行很危险。不过就我的经验来说，其实很少碰到坏人，比较麻烦的是生病。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì yí ge bēibāokè, zhè shí nián lái, yí ge rén qù guo èrshí jǐ ge guójiā. Hěn duō rén juéde nǚshēng yí ge rén lǚxíng hěn wéixiǎn. Búguò jiù wǒ de jīngyàn lái shuō, qíshí hěn shǎo pèngdào huàirén, bǐjiào máfán de shì shēngbìng.
lines.english: Hello everyone. I'm a backpacker, and in the last ten years I've been to over twenty countries on my own. Many people think it's dangerous for a woman to travel alone. But in my experience, you actually rarely meet bad people; the real trouble is getting sick.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有一次，我在偏僻的山區發燒，附近什麼都沒有，手機也沒有訊號，我難受得以為自己回不了家了。還好，當地一位老太太煮了熱湯給我喝，還讓我在她家住了三天。
lines.simplified: 有一次，我在偏僻的山区发烧，附近什么都没有，手机也没有讯号，我难受得以为自己回不了家了。还好，当地一位老太太煮了热汤给我喝，还让我在她家住了三天。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì, wǒ zài piānpì de shānqū fāshāo, fùjìn shénme dōu méiyǒu, shǒujī yě méiyǒu xùnhào, wǒ nánshòu de yǐwéi zìjǐ huí bù liǎo jiā le. Háihǎo, dāngdì yí wèi lǎotàitai zhǔ le rè tāng gěi wǒ hē, hái ràng wǒ zài tā jiā zhù le sān tiān.
lines.english: Once I had a fever in a remote mountain area. There was nothing nearby and no phone signal, and I felt so ill I thought I'd never make it home. Luckily a local old lady made me hot soup and let me stay at her home for three days.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 所以現在每次出發以前，我一定會先查好附近的醫院，藥也會多帶一些。
lines.simplified: 所以现在每次出发以前，我一定会先查好附近的医院，药也会多带一些。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ xiànzài měi cì chūfā yǐqián, wǒ yídìng huì xiān chá hǎo fùjìn de yīyuàn, yào yě huì duō dài yìxiē.
lines.english: So now, before every trip, I always look up the nearby hospitals first and bring extra medicine.

passage.english: Last autumn some friends and I went on a trip up a mountain. Before we left, the weather forecast said those days would all be sunny, and my friend said, "Since the weather's so good, let's not bring raincoats." So none of us did. But on the first afternoon, we had only just reached the mountain when the sky suddenly went dark and heavy rain began. It was very remote there: no shops nearby and a weak phone signal, so we couldn't reach the guesthouse owner and had to wait under a big tree for the rain to stop. Our clothes were soaked and the wind was strong; we were so cold we couldn't even speak clearly, and could only keep waiting. It rained all night, and as a result we didn't see the sunrise the next day either. Later I wrote about the trip on my blog, and because I wrote it in such detail, many people commented that they knew what to bring before they went.

text.traditional:
小文：
我們下個月去日本的機票，我昨天晚上上網訂了，可是付錢的時候網站一直有問題，最後沒訂成。今天早上再上網看，便宜的票已經賣完了，剩下的票一張要一萬八千元。我們說好一個人的機票不超過一萬五千元，所以我還沒買。
要是你也覺得太貴，我們就改成兩個月以後去，那時候的票只要一萬二千元。可是你那時候要準備考試，不知道去不去得成？你想想，再告訴我。
家明

text.english:
Xiaowen,
I tried to book our flights to Japan for next month online last night, but the website kept having problems when I paid, and in the end the booking didn't go through. When I looked again this morning, the cheap tickets were sold out; the tickets left cost NT$18,000 each. We agreed to spend no more than NT$15,000 per person on the flight, so I haven't bought them yet.
If you also think it's too expensive, we can go two months later instead, when tickets are only NT$12,000. But you'll be preparing for exams then, so I don't know if you'll be able to make it. Think it over and let me know.
Jiaming

text.traditional: 我姊姊旅行以前，什麼都要計畫得很詳細，連每天幾點吃飯、在哪裡吃都寫好了。我剛好跟她不一樣，喜歡想去哪裡就去哪裡。去年我們一起去日本玩了十天。前三天，我每天都跟著姊姊的行程走，累得一回到飯店就倒在床上，一點都不好玩。第四天，我們決定分開走：白天各玩各的，晚上再一起吃飯。後來，我自己走進了一條小路，發現了一家只有當地人知道的麵店，那是這次旅行最難忘的一餐。不過話說回來，就省錢來說，姊姊的方法還是比較好：十天下來，她花的錢比我少了快一半。現在我覺得，兩種旅行的方法各有各的好處，下次再跟姊姊出去，我想兩種方法一起用。
text.simplified: 我姐姐旅行以前，什么都要计画得很详细，连每天几点吃饭、在哪里吃都写好了。我刚好跟她不一样，喜欢想去哪里就去哪里。去年我们一起去日本玩了十天。前三天，我每天都跟着姐姐的行程走，累得一回到饭店就倒在床上，一点都不好玩。第四天，我们决定分开走：白天各玩各的，晚上再一起吃饭。后来，我自己走进了一条小路，发现了一家只有当地人知道的面店，那是这次旅行最难忘的一餐。不过话说回来，就省钱来说，姐姐的方法还是比较好：十天下来，她花的钱比我少了快一半。现在我觉得，两种旅行的方法各有各的好处，下次再跟姐姐出去，我想两种方法一起用。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie lǚxíng yǐqián, shénme dōu yào jìhuà de hěn xiángxì, lián měi tiān jǐ diǎn chīfàn, zài nǎlǐ chī dōu xiě hǎo le. Wǒ gānghǎo gēn tā bù yíyàng, xǐhuān xiǎng qù nǎlǐ jiù qù nǎlǐ. Qùnián wǒmen yìqǐ qù Rìběn wán le shí tiān. Qián sān tiān, wǒ měi tiān dōu gēn zhe jiějie de xíngchéng zǒu, lèi de yì huí dào fàndiàn jiù dǎo zài chuáng shàng, yìdiǎn dōu bù hǎowán. Dì sì tiān, wǒmen juédìng fēnkāi zǒu: báitiān gè wán gè de, wǎnshàng zài yìqǐ chīfàn. Hòulái, wǒ zìjǐ zǒu jìn le yì tiáo xiǎo lù, fāxiàn le yì jiā zhǐyǒu dāngdì rén zhīdào de miàn diàn, nà shì zhè cì lǚxíng zuì nánwàng de yì cān. Búguò huà shuō huílái, jiù shěngqián lái shuō, jiějie de fāngfǎ háishì bǐjiào hǎo: shí tiān xiàlái, tā huā de qián bǐ wǒ shǎo le kuài yíbàn. Xiànzài wǒ juéde, liǎng zhǒng lǚxíng de fāngfǎ gè yǒu gè de hǎochù, xià cì zài gēn jiějie chūqù, wǒ xiǎng liǎng zhǒng fāngfǎ yìqǐ yòng.
text.english: Before a trip, my older sister plans everything in detail, down to what time and where we eat each day. I'm just the opposite: I like to go wherever I feel like. Last year we spent ten days in Japan together. For the first three days I followed her schedule every day, and I was so tired I collapsed on the bed as soon as we got back to the hotel. It was no fun at all. On the fourth day we decided to split up: each of us did our own thing in the daytime, and we had dinner together in the evening. Then I wandered into a little lane by myself and found a noodle shop only the locals knew; it was the most memorable meal of the trip. But then again, when it comes to saving money, my sister's way is still better: over the ten days she spent almost half less than I did. Now I think both ways of travelling have their own good points, and next time I travel with my sister I'd like to use both ways together.

text.traditional: 上個月，我一個人去東部的山區旅行。出發前，我只跟媽媽說要去三天，沒告訴她要去哪裡。那裡很偏僻，到了第二天，手機就一點訊號都沒有了。我覺得沒什麼，第三天就回家了。沒想到我一下山，手機就響個不停。原來媽媽兩天連絡不到我，急得打了一百多通電話，差一點就去找警察了。回家以後，媽媽什麼話都沒說，只是一直哭。那時候我才知道，我一個人玩得很開心，可是家人在家裡擔心得吃不下飯。現在每次出門以前，我都會先把行程寫得清清楚楚，交給媽媽，還會告訴她哪幾天可能連絡不到我。
text.simplified: 上个月，我一个人去东部的山区旅行。出发前，我只跟妈妈说要去三天，没告诉她要去哪里。那里很偏僻，到了第二天，手机就一点讯号都没有了。我觉得没什么，第三天就回家了。没想到我一下山，手机就响个不停。原来妈妈两天连络不到我，急得打了一百多通电话，差一点就去找警察了。回家以后，妈妈什么话都没说，只是一直哭。那时候我才知道，我一个人玩得很开心，可是家人在家里担心得吃不下饭。现在每次出门以前，我都会先把行程写得清清楚楚，交给妈妈，还会告诉她哪几天可能连络不到我。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ yí ge rén qù dōngbù de shānqū lǚxíng. Chūfā qián, wǒ zhǐ gēn māma shuō yào qù sān tiān, méi gàosu tā yào qù nǎlǐ. Nàlǐ hěn piānpì, dào le dì èr tiān, shǒujī jiù yìdiǎn xùnhào dōu méiyǒu le. Wǒ juéde méi shénme, dì sān tiān jiù huíjiā le. Méixiǎngdào wǒ yí xià shān, shǒujī jiù xiǎng ge bù tíng. Yuánlái māma liǎng tiān liánluò bú dào wǒ, jí de dǎ le yìbǎi duō tōng diànhuà, chà yìdiǎn jiù qù zhǎo jǐngchá le. Huíjiā yǐhòu, māma shénme huà dōu méi shuō, zhǐshì yìzhí kū. Nà shíhòu wǒ cái zhīdào, wǒ yí ge rén wán de hěn kāixīn, kěshì jiārén zài jiālǐ dānxīn de chī bú xià fàn. Xiànzài měi cì chūmén yǐqián, wǒ dōu huì xiān bǎ xíngchéng xiě de qīngqīngchǔchǔ, jiāo gěi māma, hái huì gàosu tā nǎ jǐ tiān kěnéng liánluò bú dào wǒ.
text.english: Last month I went travelling alone in the mountains in the east. Before I left, I only told my mother I'd be away three days, not where I was going. It was very remote, and by the second day my phone had no signal at all. I didn't think much of it; I'd be home on the third day. But the moment I came down the mountain, my phone wouldn't stop ringing. My mother hadn't been able to reach me for two days, and she was so frantic she'd called over a hundred times and nearly gone to the police. When I got home, she didn't say anything; she just kept crying. Only then did I realise that while I was enjoying myself alone, my family at home was too worried to eat. Now, before every trip, I write out my plans clearly, give them to my mother, and tell her which days I may be out of reach.

text.traditional: 我弟弟從小就怕水，到了海邊，也只肯坐在海灘上看別人玩。去年夏天，他的同學都去上了游泳課，只有他不敢去。爸爸告訴他：「就算你學得比別人慢，也沒關係，我每個週末都陪你去練。」第一個月，弟弟一下水就緊張，常常喝到水。爸爸一點都不急，先讓他在水裡走，再教他把頭放進水裡，每次練完，還帶他去吃他最喜歡的冰。練了三個月，弟弟總算能自己游二十五公尺了。現在，每次一放假，他就吵著要去海邊，在水裡一玩就是一個下午，還說以後要當游泳老師。
text.simplified: 我弟弟从小就怕水，到了海边，也只肯坐在海滩上看别人玩。去年夏天，他的同学都去上了游泳课，只有他不敢去。爸爸告诉他：「就算你学得比别人慢，也没关系，我每个周末都陪你去练。」第一个月，弟弟一下水就紧张，常常喝到水。爸爸一点都不急，先让他在水里走，再教他把头放进水里，每次练完，还带他去吃他最喜欢的冰。练了三个月，弟弟总算能自己游二十五公尺了。现在，每次一放假，他就吵着要去海边，在水里一玩就是一个下午，还说以后要当游泳老师。
text.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi cóng xiǎo jiù pà shuǐ, dào le hǎibiān, yě zhǐ kěn zuò zài hǎitān shàng kàn biérén wán. Qùnián xiàtiān, tā de tóngxué dōu qù shàng le yóuyǒng kè, zhǐyǒu tā bù gǎn qù. Bàba gàosu tā: “Jiùsuàn nǐ xué de bǐ biérén màn, yě méi guānxi, wǒ měi ge zhōumò dōu péi nǐ qù liàn.” Dì yī ge yuè, dìdi yí xià shuǐ jiù jǐnzhāng, chángcháng hē dào shuǐ. Bàba yìdiǎn dōu bù jí, xiān ràng tā zài shuǐ lǐ zǒu, zài jiāo tā bǎ tóu fàng jìn shuǐ lǐ, měi cì liàn wán, hái dài tā qù chī tā zuì xǐhuān de bīng. Liàn le sān ge yuè, dìdi zǒngsuàn néng zìjǐ yóu èrshíwǔ gōngchǐ le. Xiànzài, měi cì yí fàngjià, tā jiù chǎo zhe yào qù hǎibiān, zài shuǐ lǐ yì wán jiù shì yí ge xiàwǔ, hái shuō yǐhòu yào dāng yóuyǒng lǎoshī.
text.english: My younger brother has been afraid of water since he was small; at the seaside he would only sit on the beach and watch others play. Last summer all his classmates took swimming lessons, and only he didn't dare go. Dad told him, "Even if you learn more slowly than others, it doesn't matter. I'll go and practise with you every weekend." In the first month my brother got nervous as soon as he got in the water and often swallowed water. Dad was in no hurry at all: first he let him walk in the water, then taught him to put his head under, and after every practice took him out for his favourite shaved ice. After three months of practice, my brother could finally swim twenty-five metres on his own. Now, every time there's a holiday, he begs to go to the seaside, plays in the water for a whole afternoon, and says he wants to be a swimming teacher one day.

choices.simplified: 放心去学，爸爸会一直帮他
choices.pinyin: Fàngxīn qù xué, bàba huì yìzhí bāng tā.

questions.why: 就算……也沒關係: even if he is slow, it is fine, and Dad will practise with him every weekend. Every choice is reassuring, but only this one keeps both halves: being slow is no reason to worry, and Dad will be there every weekend. Practising alone is the opposite of what Dad offers. Dad starts that summer, not next year.

text.traditional: 下個月是我媽媽五十歲的生日。我想送她一份特別的禮物，可是在網路上看來看去，還是不知道買什麼好。皮包、手錶，她早就有好幾個了；衣服呢，她又常說我的眼光不好。後來我去問爸爸，他說：「你媽媽最想要的，不是東西，是你多回家。」我這才想起來，上大學以後，我一個月只回家一次，有時候忙起來，兩個月都沒回去。所以我決定，生日那天不買禮物了，我要請一天假回家，親自做她最喜歡的菜給她吃。為了這一天，我每個週末都在宿舍跟室友學做菜，現在已經會做三道了。
text.simplified: 下个月是我妈妈五十岁的生日。我想送她一份特别的礼物，可是在网路上看来看去，还是不知道买什么好。皮包、手表，她早就有好几个了；衣服呢，她又常说我的眼光不好。后来我去问爸爸，他说：「你妈妈最想要的，不是东西，是你多回家。」我这才想起来，上大学以后，我一个月只回家一次，有时候忙起来，两个月都没回去。所以我决定，生日那天不买礼物了，我要请一天假回家，亲自做她最喜欢的菜给她吃。为了这一天，我每个周末都在宿舍跟室友学做菜，现在已经会做三道了。
text.pinyin: Xià ge yuè shì wǒ māma wǔshí suì de shēngrì. Wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn tèbié de lǐwù, kěshì zài wǎnglù shàng kàn lái kàn qù, háishì bù zhīdào mǎi shénme hǎo. Píbāo, shǒubiǎo, tā zǎojiù yǒu hǎojǐ ge le; yīfu ne, tā yòu cháng shuō wǒ de yǎnguāng bù hǎo. Hòulái wǒ qù wèn bàba, tā shuō: “Nǐ māma zuì xiǎng yào de, bú shì dōngxi, shì nǐ duō huíjiā.” Wǒ zhè cái xiǎng qǐlái, shàng dàxué yǐhòu, wǒ yí ge yuè zhǐ huíjiā yí cì, yǒu shíhòu máng qǐlái, liǎng ge yuè dōu méi huíqù. Suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng, shēngrì nà tiān bù mǎi lǐwù le, wǒ yào qǐng yì tiān jià huíjiā, qīnzì zuò tā zuì xǐhuān de cài gěi tā chī. Wèile zhè yì tiān, wǒ měi ge zhōumò dōu zài sùshè gēn shìyǒu xué zuò cài, xiànzài yǐjīng huì zuò sān dào le.
text.english: Next month is my mother's fiftieth birthday. I want to give her something special, but after looking all over online I still don't know what to buy. Handbags and watches she has had several of for ages; as for clothes, she often says I have poor taste. Then I asked my dad, and he said, "What your mum wants most isn't a thing. It's for you to come home more." Only then did I realise that since starting university I have been home just once a month, and when I'm busy I don't go back for two months. So I decided not to buy a present this time: I'll take a day off, go home and cook her favourite dishes for her myself. To get ready for that day, I've been learning to cook from my roommate in the dorm every weekend, and I can already make three dishes.
